name: Missed-Call Auto-SMS

parameters.content: This workflow listens for missed call events from Twilio, verifies that the call was not answered, sends an automated SMS response to the caller, and records the interaction by creating a lead entry in the CRM.

description: Missed-call auto-SMS - receives Twilio call-status webhooks, filters for no-answer/busy, sends an instant static SMS reply via Twilio, and the CRM Adapter creates a new lead entry with a Communication Log record (no AI calls, no Lead Score).
